result.name: SSL/TLS: Deprecated SSLv2 and SSLv3 Protocol Detection
result.description: The remote host supports the deprecated SSLv2/SSLv3 protocol.
result.solution: Disable SSLv2 and SSLv3 on the server.

result.name: Apache HTTP Server Outdated Version Detection
result.description: The remote Apache HTTP Server is outdated and vulnerable.
result.solution: Update Apache to the latest stable version.

result.name: SSH Weak Encryption Algorithms Supported
result.description: The SSH server supports weak encryption algorithms.
result.solution: Disable weak encryption algorithms in SSH configuration.

result.name: Open Telnet Port
result.description: The remote host has an open Telnet port which is unencrypted.
result.solution: Disable Telnet and use SSH instead.
